sourceQuote: Forms that are incomplete, lack a final physician’s suggestion, missing the attending physician’s signature, official hospital stamp, or applicant’s sealed photo or contain abnormal examination results will be considered invalid.
targetQuote: 表格填写不完整、缺少医师最终建议、缺少主诊医师签名、医院公章或申请人盖章照片，或体检结果异常，均视为无效。
